changes.title: Enhanced Tile Visibility
changes.text: Added an optional stronger native tile-shading setting while preserving the original terrain art and visual preference.

changes.title: Automatic Stair Navigation
changes.text: Added normal walking routes to discovered upstairs and downstairs, stopping at the destination without changing floors.

changes.title: Safe stair movement
changes.text: Stair navigation stops for enemies, damage, blocked routes and known hazards; ordinary movement remains unchanged.

changes.title: Compact stair controls
changes.text: Added one native staircase control with Up and Down choices alongside the existing dungeon controls.

changes.title: Known stair highlight
changes.text: Selecting discovered stairs briefly highlights their exact tile without exposing undiscovered terrain or replacing combat warnings.

changes.title: Saved accessibility choices
changes.text: Added persistent Enhanced Tile Visibility and Automatic Stair Navigation choices, both off by default.

changes.title: Android travel and visibility
changes.text: Added real-touch stair-menu checks, travel and interruption checks, save/reload checks and original/enhanced screenshots at two zoom levels.

changes.title: Cleric and stair layout
changes.text: Extended Android overlap checks to include the stair control alongside all four Cleric spell buttons.

changes.title: Android visual evidence
changes.text: Added six required gameplay screenshots to the artifact checks alongside the existing five history comparisons.

changes.title: Verified private staging
changes.text: Staged the tested preceding APK with exact signer, checksum, source and test evidence before preparing the new features.

changes.title: Current verification record
changes.text: Updated the shared handoff, report and full build request for the accessibility and navigation additions.

changes.title: Original Visuals And Existing Controls Are The Defaults
changes.text: Added a check that both new options preserve the original visuals and controls by default.

changes.title: Both Options Persist Across Preference Reload
changes.text: Added a check that both choices remain saved across preference reloads.

changes.title: Turning Enhancement Off Preserves The Original Grid Choice
changes.text: Added a check that disabling tile enhancement restores the player's original visual-grid choice.

changes.title: Damage Cancels Even When Normal Damage Interruption Was Disabled
changes.text: Added a regression check that taking damage cancels stair travel even when ordinary damage interruption was disabled.

changes.title: Restored Hero Does Not Resume Transient Navigation
changes.text: Added a save regression check that the hero's position and health survive reload without restarting transient stair travel.

changes.title: Walking Pays The Normal Movement Cost Without Changing Floors
changes.text: Added a real movement check for normal turn cost and unchanged floor depth.

changes.title: Offscreen And Obscured Known Stairs Still Have Exact Destinations
changes.text: Added a check that known stairs outside the current field of view remain valid destinations while unknown stairs remain concealed.

changes.title: Both Directions Choose Only Their Own Stair
changes.text: Added a check that upstairs and downstairs resolve to their corresponding destinations.

changes.title: Undiscovered Stair Does Not Expose Its Location
changes.text: Added a check that undiscovered stairs cannot expose a destination.

changes.title: Mapped Stairs Are Already Known
changes.text: Added a check that previously mapped stairs count as discovered.

changes.title: Missing Direction Cannot Fall Back To Other Stair
changes.text: Added a check that a missing staircase cannot silently select the opposite direction.

changes.title: Known Traps And Pits Are Unsafe But Secret Traps Are Not Revealed
changes.text: Added a check that known active traps and pits are avoided without revealing secret traps.

changes.title: Blocked Avoided And Unknown Tiles Are Unsafe
changes.text: Added a check that blocked, unsafe and unexplored tiles cannot enter a stair route.

changes.title: Visible Fire Is Unsafe Without Revealing Unseen Gas
changes.text: Added a check that visible environmental danger blocks travel without exposing unseen effects.

changes.title: Enemy Prevents Navigation Without Using A Turn
changes.text: Added a check that a visible enemy prevents stair travel without consuming a turn.

changes.title: Normal Move Is Selected Instead Of Floor Transition
changes.text: Added a check that selecting stairs creates a normal movement action instead of a floor-transition action.

changes.title: Manual Cancellation Cannot Resume A Stale Stair Route
changes.text: Added a check that cancelled stair travel cannot be resumed as a stale route.

changes.title: Blocked Stair Has No Route
changes.text: Added a check that blocked stairs return an unavailable-route message.

changes.title: Navigation Does Not Consume Randomness Or Change Terrain
changes.text: Added a check that selecting a stair route leaves gameplay randomness and terrain unchanged.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I added optional tile contrast and a shortcut for walking to known stairs. Both preserve ordinary game turns and saves, with new checks for interruption, layout and visual behavior.
